KO/EN/DE: actual fictional expert/host interview,20/12 display-fatigue self-reports versus24/15 recycling-ease reports. Separate actual response count from unmeasured objective fatigue/waste and unsupported sole cause. Host raises certainty/scope/frequency with no new evidence; expert preserves valid count while correcting all/always/must. Unknown remaining answers not automatically adverse, review worth separate obligation, expected tendency separate law, intended follow-up inferred not approved. Comparable nonreplication can weaken scope, no invented result. Seven required criteria.

KO/EN/DE: original abstract, overclaiming report and distinct commentary. Self-report definition, volunteers/single facility/no comparison arm, unknown nonparticipants and other changes; confirmed positive count not universal cause. Reporter alone claims mandatory adoption, no extra source. Commentary separates possibility/value/obligation/frequency and compares immediate full adoption versus limited follow-up under common verification/choice criteria with unknown costs. Seven required contrasts.

KO/EN/DE: two mandatory complete free fields, specialist and public summaries. Keep confirmed counts firm while reserving uncertain cause, preserve sample/selection bias/unmeasured outcomes, propose possible counterevidence without claiming it occurred. Explicitly compare full adoption and limited follow-up under same effect-verification/choice criteria. Source comparison and revision with certainty/frequency/obligation separately calibrated; full meaning and argument unscored.

KO/EN/DE: polite equal colleague questions preserve expected benefit while challenging all/always/must separately, narrower joint conclusion and unknowns. Review worth versus effect likelihood in separate sentences, formal public briefing, Korean mediation of possibility-to-obligation and self-report-to-objective-effect transfer. Replay pauses/focus and revise; meaning/intonation unscored.
